svg.title: Buddhist Path to Unbinding - Class Diagram

g.text: Buddhist Path to Unbinding - Class Diagram
Qualities: Calmed, Joyful, Concentrated, Pliant, Malleable, Luminous, NotBrittle
Nature: Inconstant, Stressful, Disease, Cancer, Arrow, Painful, Affliction
Composition: Four Primary Elements (Earth, Liquid, Fire, Wind)
Manifestations: Birth, Aging, Death, Sorrow, Lamentation, Pain, Distress, Despair
Characteristics: Deathless, Cessation of All Suffering & Stress, Effluent-free
Status: Root Destroyed, Not Destined for Future Arising
Purpose: Conducive to Goal, Basic to Holy Life, Leads to Unbinding
Qualities: Admirable (beginning, middle, end), Perfect, Pure
Titles: Worthy, Rightly Self-Awakened, Consummate in Clear-Knowing & Conduct, Well-Gone, Expert in Cosmos, Unexcelled Trainer, Teacher of Devas & Humans, Blessed
Role: Arouser of Unarisen Path, Eye, Knowledge, Brahmā
Truths: Stress, Origination of Stress, Cessation of Stress, Path of Practice
Nature: Deep, Regularity of Dhamma, Orderliness of Dhamma
Components: Right View, Right Resolve, Right Speech, Right Action, Right Livelihood, Right Effort, Right Mindfulness, Right Concentration
Practice: Restraint (Pāṭimokkha), Seeing Danger in Faults
Practice: Discerning Four Noble Truths, Investigating Fabrications
Function: Fosters Mind Development, Abandons Passion
Function: Fosters Discernment Development, Abandons Ignorance
Outcome: Heightened Mental State, Pleasant Abiding
Process: Secluded from Sensuality & Unskillful Qualities, Progresses through Rapture, Pleasure, Unification, Equanimity, Pure Mindfulness [AN_nblm.txt (from prior analysis)]
Core: Singleness of Mind [AN_nblm.txt (from prior analysis)]
Types: Immeasurable (Goodwill, Compassion, Empathetic Joy, Equanimity)
Qualities: Established, Unmuddled, Ardent, Alert, Resolute
Practice: Immersion in Body, In-&Out Breathing
Components: Name (Feeling, Perception, Intention, Contact, Attention); Form (Four Great Elements, dependent forms)
Types: Eye, Ear, Nose, Tongue, Body, Intellect
Types: Pleasure, Pain, Neither Pleasure Nor Pain
Forms: Sensuality, Precepts, Views, Doctrine of Self
Constituents: Form, Feeling, Perception, Fabrications, Consciousness
Types: Direct Knowledge, Knowledge of Ending Effluents
Types: Sensual Desire, Ill Will, Sloth & Drowsiness, Restlessness & Anxiety, Uncertainty
Nature: Assumption of Self or 'I am' conceit
Elements: Earth, Liquid, Fire, Wind, Space, Consciousness
